title: Thank you
content:
My 10 year old daughter had ear ache 
I called at 8am 
Was called back by 845
She was seen and treated by 915
We couldn’t ask for better care 
The doctor who saw her was kind and personable 
Thank you so much
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
